Georg Jensen's World of Silver Earrings

Many women feel undressed without their earrings. They are the little detail that adds a hint of femininity to a work outfit or the last finishing touch of glamour to evening-wear. They may not be the largest piece of jewelry but sterling silver earrings for women can make a big difference to the way you look and the way you feel.

Traditional rules say that simple sterling silver hoop earrings or understated studs are best for daytime but they need not be boring! We offer many striking examples that are discrete enough to wear for work but have unusual organic forms or unique details. And many come as sterling silver clip on earrings so don't worry if you do not have piercings.

For evening, sterling silver dangle earrings are the most glamorous and we have everything from delicate contemporary designs to bold sculptural shapes. Feel free to mix and match - they don't have to be worn as a pair. And if you have more than one piercing in your ear, experiment by using both sterling silver drop earrings and studs to create a truly individual style.
